text:
ruth-pm: Quick recap from the Acme sync: they want a marketplace private-offer that bundles committed cloud spend + per-device hardware rebate. They asked for a clear field-facing playbook and an ops-safe reconciliation flow. Can we align on mechanics?

ben-sales: Sales priorities: 1) show effective net price on SKU page, 2) one-page play with 3 examples sellers can copy, 3) avoid multi-step approvals for Starter deals.

acme-partner: Acme prefers checkout-applied credits (customer sees discount immediately) and a per-device rebate paid quarterly. We can provide serial feeds to validate devices.

luke-partnereng: Checkout credit = best UX but requires SKU-level entitlement + partner co-fund wiring. Estimate: spike + 3 sprints to fully support across NA/EU. Fallback is post-bill rebate (reconciliation) which is faster to ship.

helen-legal: Legal items: cap aggregate rebates per-customer per-year, require serial proof for device rebates, include a 12-month clawback provision for fraud, and an audit right. Also insist on clear expiry rules for credits.

tasha-pricing: Pricing ops suggestions: map % marketplace credits to absolute SKU credit amounts (so CPQ can calculate net price). Floor: net-effective discount should not drop below 12% after marketplace fees + rebates. Propose expiry: 6 months for marketplace promo credits; 9 months for device rebates.

ruth-pm: Proposal from product: three tiers -> Starter (10% credit + $75/device), Growth (20% + $200/device), Enterprise (30% + custom rebate; manual approval). Thoughts?

ben-sales: Good. Gate Growth/Enterprise to partner-ops review. Starter should be self-serve in CPQ. Sales wants calculator widget embedded in the SKU page.

luke-partnereng: We'll need SKU mapping CSV from pricing ops with marketplace_sku_id, partner_sku_id, credit_amount_usd, expiry_days. Also need a reconciliation webhook to send used-credit events to partners.

acme-partner: Can Acme receive aggregated daily usage + credit consumption? We can reconcile quarterly. Need a cap per quarter to limit exposure.

helen-legal: Partner reporting OK but must be aggregated and anonymized unless NDA + limited access. We'll add a partner appendix to the contract for reporting + data access scope.

ruth-pm: Operational flow decision: apply credits at checkout (preferred) but allow manual fallback to post-bill rebate for edge cases. If we choose checkout, we must publish SLA: partner evidence processed within 7 business days for rebate payouts.

tasha-pricing: Ops note: if partner pays gross credit (customer sees full discount) we must record partner settlement entries net of marketplace transaction fees. Ops prefers partner pays gross.

ben-sales: FAQ request: what happens on downgrade, renewal, and partial device returns? Sales wants clear scripts: credits expire, remaining credits can be applied to first invoice of a new contract but do not extend term. Returns trigger clawback per legal.

luke-partnereng: Implementation tasks: (1) private-offer extension to support rebate_lines: {sku_id, amount_usd, expiry_days, evidence_type}, (2) partner portal endpoint for serial upload + verification webhook, (3) reporting feed for partner co-fund reconciliation. I'll open GH RFC.

helen-legal: Add dispute window: partners have 60 days post-quarter to raise reconciliation disputes. After that, amounts are final. Also define a process for clawbacks and appeals.

acme-partner: We'll share proposed quarterly co-fund cap and sample serial export by EOD tomorrow.

ruth-pm: Marketing ask: avoid publishing exact $ rebates; use ranges and 2 partner case studies. Marketing needs assets 3 weeks before the public announcement.

ben-sales: Training requests: 1-pager + two short roleplay scripts for sellers handling renewal & downgrade questions.

tasha-pricing: I'll convert the tier %s to SKU credit USD values and circulate a template CSV by Wed. Also will include the floor calculations (12% net).

luke-partnereng: Dev estimate: 3 sprints for checkout path spike+work, 1 sprint for partner reporting, 1 sprint for portal UX. Canary NA, then EU.

ruth-pm: Timeline proposal: if numbers finalize by next Fri, legal & marketing review the following week, soft launch 6 weeks after. Otherwise shift announcement. Who owns exec sign-off?

helen-legal: Legal will prepare appendix draft and sign-off checklist. Exec sign-off: partnership leadership + finance must approve co-fund liability cap.

gm-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Acme commit+rebate launch sync" Mon 09:30 PT, 30m. Invite sent to participants. :calendar:

ruth-pm: Summary actions: (1) tasha -> SKU CSV + floor calc by Wed, (2) luke -> RFC for private-offer + portal tasks, (3) helen -> contract appendix draft by Thu, (4) acme-partner -> co-fund cap & serial sample by EOD tomorrow, (5) ben -> sales play 1-pager draft. Sync Mon 09:30 PT. Thanks everyone.
